en:
## New Features

- The narrator message list now uses the exact-layout renderer by default: row heights are computed without touching the DOM, so scrolling long conversations no longer jumps or reflows
- Full rendering coverage for tool calls, tool runs, subagents, reasoning, media, markdown and LaTeX math (KaTeX), with syntax highlighting driven by a bounded token cache
- Long histories load tail-first and extend upward on demand (reverse infinite scroll) instead of fetching the whole conversation before the first screen
- Added per-narrator full-text message search that jumps straight to the matching message in the list
- Message editing moved into a dedicated panel with image and text-file attachments, paste, and undo
- Subagents orphaned by a narrator error can now be recovered: resume them in place, or collect all their results in a single turn
- Plugins can contribute per-user themes declared as whitelisted design tokens, so appearance is extensible without granting a plugin any code execution; theme-only packages install without admin rights
- NUG: when a model's whole credential pool is temporarily exhausted, the turn suspends and waits for recovery instead of repeatedly retrying the full request
- NUG: the model list refreshes automatically after a successful login
- Added model preferences and allowed-model pools for review and search subagents
- ContextAsk now streams a live character counter

## Bug Fixes

- Mobile: page scrolling now has a single owner, with keyboard-aware safe areas across overlays and routes
- Mobile: narrator status actions collapse into an overflow menu instead of being clipped
- Recent tabs no longer regress when a delayed API response arrives after newer WebSocket state
- Interrupted subagent turns now resume instead of returning partial output as a successful result
- Browser session handoff across planned updates is transactional and rolls back on failure
- Codex: a recovered Agent Identity task retries its usage lookup, so healthy credentials are no longer marked banned
- Migrations apply by hash membership rather than a timestamp watermark, self-healing a database whose migration table was polluted by branch or version switching
- The service worker now precaches the actually emitted app shell instead of stale disk output

## Security

- Bash analysis: a numeric argument no longer shifts later arguments out of the path scope check. Previously a command like `grep 42 ../../etc/passwd` hid its path from the worktree boundary check and could be auto-approved as read-only
- A long `sleep` no longer counts as read-only, since it holds the execution window until timeout
- Plugin theme background assets are restricted to raster images, keeping the unauthenticated same-origin asset route from serving active content
- Message search sanitizes full-text query input so operator characters cannot alter the query

## Performance

- Upward pagination rebuilds cost O(new items) through a measurement cache keyed on the document version
- Removed a full COUNT(*) scan from the narrator first-screen load
- Message search returns snippets and previews rather than full message content
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 叙述者消息列表默认改用精确布局渲染器：行高不经过 DOM 测量即可算出，长对话滚动不再跳动或重排
- 渲染覆盖补齐：工具调用、工具运行、子代理、推理、媒体、Markdown 和 LaTeX 数学公式（KaTeX），语法高亮由有上限的 token 缓存驱动
- 长历史改为从尾部加载、按需向上扩展（反向无限滚动），首屏不再拉取整段对话
- 新增叙述者内消息全文搜索，可直接跳转到命中的那条消息
- 消息编辑独立为专门面板，支持图片与文本文件附件、粘贴和撤销
- 因叙述者报错而被孤立的子代理现在可以恢复：原地继续运行，或在一个回合内统一收集全部结果
- 插件可以贡献按用户生效的主题，以白名单设计令牌声明，扩展外观无需授予插件任何代码执行能力；纯主题包普通用户即可安装
- NUG：模型的整个凭证池临时耗尽时，回合改为挂起等待恢复，不再反复重试整个请求
- NUG：登录成功后自动刷新模型列表
- 新增评审与搜索子代理的模型偏好和可用模型池
- ContextAsk 支持实时字符计数

## 修复

- 移动端：页面滚动收敛到单一归属，浮层与路由统一适配键盘感知安全区
- 移动端：叙述者状态栏操作在空间不足时收进溢出菜单，不再被裁切
- 修复延迟返回的 API 响应覆盖更新的 WebSocket 状态，导致最近标签页回退的问题
- 被中断的子代理回合改为续跑，不再把不完整输出当成成功结果返回
- 计划更新期间的浏览器会话移交改为事务性，失败时回滚
- Codex：Agent Identity 任务重新注册后会重试用量查询，健康凭证不再被误标为封禁
- 迁移改为按哈希判定待执行项，不再依赖时间戳水位，可自愈因切换分支或版本而被污染的迁移记录
- Service Worker 改为预缓存真实产出的应用外壳，不再使用磁盘上的旧文件

## 安全

- Bash 分析：数字参数不再把后续参数挤出路径作用域检查。此前形如 `grep 42 ../../etc/passwd` 的命令会让路径对 worktree 边界检查隐身，从而被当作只读命令免询问放行
- 长时间 `sleep` 不再算作只读命令，因为它会占满整个执行窗口直到超时
- 插件主题背景资源限制为位图，避免无需认证的同源资源路由投递可执行内容
- 消息搜索对全文查询输入做净化，防止操作符字符改变查询语义

## 性能优化

- 向上分页的重建成本降为 O(新增条目)，测量缓存以文档版本为键
- 移除叙述者首屏加载中的全量 COUNT(*) 扫描
- 消息搜索只返回片段和预览，不再携带完整消息内容
